content.thinking: Another test bug — `D(0,'abc')` is not valid hex (also odd length). I meant `b'abc'` = '616263'. Let me fix all such occurrences. Let me grep for `D(0,'` with non-hex content.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
src = open('test_bridge2.py').read()
src = src.replace("D(0,'abc')", "D(0,'616263')")
open('test_bridge2.py','w').write(src)
EOF
grep -n "D(0,'" test_bridge2.py | head -20; python3 test_bridge2.py
